_comment: EXAMPLE acquisition data-room ACL policy (manager-can/employee-cannot per document). Copy to the path in GENBI_DATA_ROOM_POLICY_PATH (default data/genbi/data_room_acl.json) and edit. This file is a template — the live policy source is deployment state, never committed. Grants name a principal directly (principal:<identity>) or a role (role:<role>); an empty/missing allow list grants nobody. The policy source is re-read on every decision (uncached), so edits take effect on the next search.
